messages:
alex: Heads-up — EdgeMed SI is stuck on the final private deployment checklist. Customer wants a 10am PST arch sync tomorrow. Primary blockers: telemetry ingestion shape + customer firewall rules. tagging @priya @marco for architecture and delivery.
priya: I can do 10am. do we have the sequence diagram they shared? also need their expected qps and KV cache hit rate estimates.
alex: attaching the snippet they pasted in email (copied):
```
{"ingest_endpoint": "https://hooks.edgemed.example/v1/llm-events", "batch_size": 8, "approx_qps": 12}
```
marco: rough concerns: if they're using our VPC-private package we need to verify egress to our telemetry ingestion endpoint and ensure mutual TLS. their infra team said they only allow outbound 443 to a set of FQDNs — need exact hostnames we own.
kevin: listing what we need from customer network side:
- outbound to telemetry.redwood.example:443 (mTLS)
- ports 22 (for initial bootstrap) and 443/8443 for control plane
- allow persistent websocket to runtime-gw.redwood.example:443 for KV cache notifications
If they can't open websocket, fallback will poll which increases load.
sarah: @alex can you confirm if EdgeMed is on Dedicated or Private? that changes the cert story.
alex: they're doing Private (customer-managed VPC) with our private control plane. timeline wants go-live next week.
priya: ok, for Private we require customer to trust our CA or we provide signed certs via the onboarding flow. I need their PKI contact. who owns that on the edge side?
alex: contact is j.morris@edgemed — their SI lead. I asked for network diagram but haven't got it yet.
marco: also flagging a potential implementation gap: their SI used an older DH parameter for TLS and our runtime rejects weak params. can we provide a compatibility shim?
kevin: short-term: we can relax the TLS validation in the ingress proxy for that customer under a controlled rollout, but that requires ops approval. will open a ticket and link here.
deploy-bot: Ticket #INF-4721 created by kevin: "EdgeMed Private: TLS compatibility + telemetry egress hostnames". Assigned to eng-infra.
kevin: INF-4721 — added acceptance criteria: list of hostnames we advertise, test plan for websocket fallback, and ops checklist for controlled validation relaxation.
tim_sales: looping in customer success — @tim_sales — customer is sensitive to PHI transfer, they asked for KMS integration notes and audit log retention.
priya: noted — for KMS we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM on Private. I'll prepare a short doc snippet for the arch call.
alex: we just got a failure log from the SI earlier today, pasted below:
```
2024-06-30T17:22:03Z ERROR connection failed: tls: handshake failure: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
POST /v1/events 502
```
marco: yup that's the DH/TLS issue. ask them to try curl with `-v` from the SI bastion and paste output. we can triage faster with that.
kevin: ops note — if we do relaxation we will enable strict mode after their infra upgrades. need approval from eng-sre leads. I pinged @kevin and @sarah in eng-sre channel.
sarah: approved conditional relaxation for one-hour rollback window, but only after SIG-ops runbook entry is created. can you draft the runbook @kevin?
kevin: will do. drafting now and will attach to INF-4721.
tim_sales: customer asked whether the go-live can be delayed one day if we need the cert rotation. they prefer reliability > rushing.
alex: relay to SI: we propose arch sync tomorrow 10am PST, and offer go/no-go by EOD after tests. will confirm with EdgeMed.
priya: prepping diagram + KMS snippet. will drop into this thread before 9pm PT.
marco: also adding a short checklist for the arch call:
- ports & FQDNs verified
- mutual TLS cert chain validated
- websocket allowed or polling configured
- KMS & audit retention documented
- fallback model variant for lower-memory nodes tested
If any item fails, escalate to delivery PM.
alex: thanks all. cc @tim_sales to confirm customer availability. I'll follow up with SI to get the bastion curl output.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: Arch sync meeting created for 2024-07-02T17:00:00Z (10am PST).
